[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra I.29 (Samādhipāda) — Tataḥ pratyakcetanādhigamo'pyantarāyābhāvaśca | Pages 321-324]

ṣaś ca bhavatīty
uktam, idānīṃ tayor madhya īśvarapraṇidhānasya mukhyakalpatvaṃ pratipādayituṃ tatra
dvārādhikyaṃ sūtreṇa pratipādayati-- kiṃcāsyeti / Anyac cāsya praṇidhānino bhavatīty arthaḥ /
Tataḥ pratyakcetanādhigamo'py antarāyābhāvaś ca / Tata īśvarapraṇidhānāt tatsākṣātkāradvārā
taddṛṣṭāntena jīvatattvam apy anāyāsena pūrṇatayā sākṣāt kriyata iti prathamadalārthaḥ / Apiśabda
āsannatamasamādhyapekṣayā
/
Yad
api
prati
prativastu,
añcati
anugacchatīti
vyutpattyāsaṃkucitasarvānugataḥ paramātmaiva mukhya pratyakśabdārthaḥ-- Pratyakpraśāntaṃ
bhagavacchabdasaṃjñaṃ yad vāsudevaṃ kavayo vadanti // ity ādiṣv apīśvare pratyakprayogadarśanāc
